text:
deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff for release v2026.03.22 — starting staged FF ramp for 'model-route-v3' at global 5% (canary cohort). Pinning model-version=llama-2-13b-q4a for canary. Watchers: latency, 5xx, 429s. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/17456abc :rocket:
sarah: Copy. I'll watch p50/p95 and error budget. If p50 > 120ms or 5xx spike -> hold/rollback.
marco: Reminder to document the pin in the release notes and ops playbook. Also capture KV cache metrics; we've seen regressions with fresh KV loads.
ops-bot: Canary health check: 1m OK, CPU 62%, mem 74%, kv_cache_hit_rate=92%, tok/sec stable. No 5xx yet.
leo: Flagging a small bump in 429s from eu-west (starting ~30s after ramp). Could be bursty traffic to that shard.
sarah: I'm going to pause eu-west and set eu-west=0% to isolate. Global stays 5% for others.
marco: Command to run:
```
/deploybot ff update model-route-v3 --region eu-west --percent 0
```
deploy-bot: Command received. Updated: model-route-v3 eu-west=0%, global=5%. Canary remains pinned to model-version=llama-2-13b-q4a.
dev-sre: Observability note: traces show tail latency increase on requests >1024 tokens (tokenization/kv-pop). Dropping global to 2% to reduce blast radius while we dig in.
sarah: Scaling back global to 2% now. If no regressions in 15m we'll resume a gradual ramp to 20% over 60m with region-specific holdpoints.
marco: I'll update release notes: "Staged rollout of model-route-v3 with regional hold for eu-west; canary pinned to llama-2-13b-q4a; rollback plan: unpin and revert traffic to model-version v2026.02.11; resumptions gated by tokenized tail latency and KV hit-rate."
sarah: :thumbsup: I'll keep monitoring. If p95 > 300ms or 5xx > 0.5% we abort and roll back immediately.
ops-bot: Alert rule set: p95 > 300ms OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% triggers auto-hold + pager.
leo: Thanks — leaving an annotation in the deploy doc with timestamp and actions taken.
marco: Note for post-deploy: we should run a focused perf run with long-context requests to reproduce tail latency before next ramp.
sarah: Agreed. I'll schedule that in the next 2h window.
